title: API floor
wikitext:
= floor =

== Usage ==
val = floor(value);

== Description ==
floor(value) returns the floor of the value (essentially it returns the whole part of the value) i.e. rounds value ''down''

== Example ==
 > local x = floor(10.9);
 > = x
 10

 -- Rounding using floor()
 > local x = floor(value + .5)
